index_basis: Zero-based parsed_document.json content_stream array; every range is start inclusive, end exclusive.
scope_rule: First 20 definite, individually described burial/grave records in source reading order; one record per grave, not per individual. Unnumbered but uniquely identifiable Einzelgrab qualifies. Uncertain grave existence, stray finds, settlements, and aggregate-only graves excluded. Uncertain attributes or inventory associations do not alone negate definite grave existence.

shared_context.explanation: Conservative context envelope only; per-record mandatoryContextBlocks below identifies the subset required for schema interpretation. Other blocks here are optional or unrelated conventions.

range_note: record_block_range is complete mandatory record content. mandatoryContextBlocks gives the additional mandatory source indices. complete_source_block_ranges and contiguous_source_envelope are conservative source packages, not mandatory-coverage requirements; envelopes can include sibling records. Reading order remains record_block_range.start.
context_coverage_criterion: Mandatory coverage is the complete record_block_range plus mandatoryContextBlocks: source blocks carrying site/feature identity, applicable measurements or abbreviations, inherited excavation/date/depth information, and definitions needed for actual schema fields. Bibliography, acknowledgements, illustration-only explanation, detailed limb-angle thresholds, ceramic description conventions, and object-view geometry are optional or unrelated to this schema. Their absence alone is not a semantic scope failure. These refined classifications supersede the earlier conservative complete_source_block_ranges/envelope as a mandatory-coverage test.
